FIELDS.NAME: Precision Tire & Auto Center
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Precision Tire & Auto Center specializes in tire sales, installation, and maintenance services for passenger vehicles and light trucks. We offer routine automotive services such as oil changes, battery replacements, and fluid top-offs. Our operations focus on maintaining high safety standards; all our technicians are certified and receive regular training on equipment use and hazardous material handling. We only sell and install new tires sourced from reputable manufacturers, ensuring quality and safety for our customers. Additionally, we conduct tire inspections and provide preventive maintenance to help reduce vehicle failures. Our facility is designed with a customer waiting area, ensuring clear separation between service bays and public spaces to enhance safety. We concentrate on providing reliable tire and basic maintenance services while adhering strictly to all environmental and waste disposal regulations.

reviews: I had a fantastic experience at this Tire & Automotive Center! They quickly came to my rescue when my car broke down nearby—great to know there’s a place that provides towing services and repairs all in one!

The prices are reasonable, and I appreciate their honesty about what my car needed.
I love that they offer a comfortable waiting area while you get your car serviced.
Highly recommend! They really know their stuff and made my experience hassle-free.
